about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am interested in the ever-evolving relationship between humans and artificial intelligence.
about.p2: I do not view AI merely as a tool; rather, I seek to explore how autonomous agents can think, collaborate, and solve problems within larger, more complex systems.
about.p3: My journey is driven by curiosity and a spirit of experimentation—constantly testing, learning from mistakes, and refining my approach to achieve my goals.
about.p4: To me, AI is not just a technology, but a new paradigm for problem-solving—one that unlocks entirely new possibilities.

workflow.title: AI Workflow
workflow.intro: Designing intelligent workflows that are reliable, efficient, and scalable.
workflow.decompositionText: Break complex tasks into manageable steps.
workflow.ioText: Maintain clear input and output between tasks.
workflow.qualityText: Validate results at every critical stage.
workflow.errorsText: Detect, recover, and prevent recurring errors.
workflow.scalabilityText: Build modular workflows that are easy to maintain and extend.
workflow.philosophy: Build workflows around problems, not the number of AI agents.
